name: Balatonkeresztúr (Hungary)
description: Quartered yellow and red, with yellow in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Balatonkeresztúr: a blue and red shield with a church and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Balatonkeresztúr arms with helm, crest and mantling
